card.title: A Shopping Cart Store With Signals

a1.cap: Manage cart state in a service: add items (merging quantities), remove items, and expose derived totals that every component can read. Keep the state read-only from outside.

lines: Manage cart state in a service: add items (merging quantities), remove items, and expose derived totals that every component can read. Keep the state read-only from outside.

a1.cap: A root service owns a private writable signal and exposes a read-only view. Methods describe the allowed changes and compute new immutable arrays, while computed values such as the total update automatically.
This covers most app state needs before reaching for a state library.
The writable signal is private, so only the store can change it.
Components get a read-only signal: they can read it but not write it.
count and total are derived and always consistent.
Adding an existing item merges quantities instead of duplicating the line.
Immutable updates: create new objects, so signals detect the change.
remove produces a new array without the item.
That's it! Read the full code below, then try building it yourself.
